title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After her party defeats the Demon King, the long-lived elf mage Frieren outlives her human companions. When the hero Himmel dies, she regrets never knowing him better and sets out toward the resting place of souls, traveling with Fern, an orphan raised by the priest Heiter, and Stark, a young warrior.
life_message: Holds up paying attention to the people around you while you can, and carrying their kindness forward after they are gone.
